decision_conditions:
<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
 </ol><p>The
     proposed two storey rear extension, by reason of its proximity to the rear
     of the application site, would result in poor levels of outlook and access
     to daylight/sunlight to the kitchen/dining area serving the flat of the
     application site. The proposal would be detrimental to the amenities of
     the occupiers at No. 113 Headstone Road, contrary to Policy D3.D(7) of the
     London Plan (2021), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies
     Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted
     Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
</ol>
description: 'Single and two storey side to rear extension; rear dormer; two rooflights in front roof slope; external staircase to rear; external alterations; 2m high brick boundary wall to side; bin / cycle storage (demolition of external staircase)'

phasing_details.phase_detail: Ground Floor Rear Extension and Infill Extension
